audience: businesses that use Pin Payments to collect payments and manage subscriptions

useCases.title: Review charges and their refunds
useCases.text: Find recent charges, inspect a payment and review refunds already issued against it. The server does not charge or refund customers.

useCases.title: Check available and pending balances
useCases.text: Read the account’s available and pending balances by currency, with amounts reported in the currency’s base unit.

useCases.title: Reconcile a transfer with its ledger entries
useCases.text: Find a bank transfer and inspect the charges, fees, refunds and chargebacks that make up its ledger line items.

useCases.title: Review disputes and their activity
useCases.text: Find disputes, inspect their status and deadlines, and review recorded activity before deciding what to handle in Pin Payments.

useCases.title: Inspect a subscription and its ledger
useCases.text: Find a subscription, review its plan and next billing date, and inspect existing ledger credits and debits without changing the subscription.
